zh.title: 國防部偵獲共機5架次與共艦8艘　其中3架次逾越海峽中線
zh.summary: 國防部表示，自8月1日上午6時至2日上午6時止，共偵獲5架次共機、8艘共艦及2艘公務船在台海周邊活動。其中有3架次共機逾越台灣海峽中線並進入西南空域。國軍對此運用任務機艦與岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控應處。
body: 國防部於8月2日上午公布最新的共機與共艦動態資訊。統計顯示，自8月1日上午6時起至8月2日上午6時止，國軍共偵獲5架次共機、8艘共艦以及2艘公務船，持續在台灣海峽周邊海空域活動。
國防部說明，在偵獲的5架次共機當中，有3架次逾越台灣海峽中線並進入西南空域。面對共軍海空軍動態，國軍運用任務機艦與岸置飛彈系統進行嚴密監控與妥善應處。
另據本站統計紀錄顯示，前一次於8月1日記錄之動態資料中，國軍共偵獲5架次共機、10艘共艦以及2艘公務船。

en.title: Taiwan Tracks 5 PLA Aircraft and 8 Naval Vessels with 3 Crossing Median Line
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported detecting five PLA aircraft, eight PLA Navy vessels, and two official ships operating around Taiwan between 6:00 a.m. on August 1 and 6:00 a.m. on August 2. According to defense authorities, three of the detected PLA aircraft crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait and entered the southwestern air defense zone. In response, Taiwan's military deployed mission aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the activities around the island.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense released its latest tracking report on August 2 regarding military activities around the island. Between 6:00 a.m. on August 1 and 6:00 a.m. on August 2, defense authorities detected five PLA aircraft, eight PLA Navy vessels, and two official ships operating in the air and maritime space surrounding Taiwan.

According to the defense report, three of the five detected PLA aircraft crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait and entered the southwestern air defense identification zone. In response, Taiwan's armed forces deployed combat aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems to maintain strict surveillance and handle the situation.
According to this site's statistical records, the previous tracking data recorded on August 1 included five PLA aircraft, ten PLA Navy vessels, and two official ships operating in the area.

zh.title: 皇家史基浦集團上半年投資8.01億歐元 總旅客量達3730萬人次
zh.summary: 皇家史基浦集團於2026年前六個月投入創紀錄的8.01億歐元改善機場品質，為2035年前投資100億歐元更新計畫的一環。旗下三大機場同期接待3730萬人次旅客，其中阿姆斯特丹史基浦機場占3270萬人次。集團同時發行5億歐元債券以維持現金流，且最安靜兩類機型占比提升至38%。
body: 皇家史基浦集團公布2026年前六個月營運與財務數據。今年1月至6月期間，集團旗下的阿姆斯特丹史基浦機場、埃因霍溫機場與鹿特丹海牙機場等三座機場，總計接待3730萬人次旅客，與去年同期相比成長0.3%。其中，主要樞紐阿姆斯特丹史基浦機場承載了3270萬人次旅客的絕大部分旅運需求。
在2026年前六個月期間，皇家史基浦集團針對旗下機場品質投入創紀錄的8.01億歐元資金。這項投資計畫符合該集團至2035年前投入100億歐元用於史基浦機場全面更新的整體長期策略。上半年完成的具體投資項目包括完成A碼頭建置，並進一步擴充支援設施電動化的相關容量。
此外，作為史基浦中心整體規劃（Schiphol Centre Master Plan）龐大方案的一環，機場營運業者共支付3.17億歐元款項，用於搬遷荷蘭皇家航空（KLM）旗下的多棟建築物。為了順利推展各項投資計畫與品質提升工程，並同時維持健康的現金流，史基浦集團於此期間發行了5億歐元的債券。
在噪音減緩與永續營運方面，史基浦機場於2025年所推出的新型機場收費結構已顯現效果。統計顯示，在2026年上半年，起降於該機場的航空器中，屬於最安靜兩個類別的機型比例已達38%，高於2025年同期的29%，顯示出營運機型持續朝向更低噪音方向轉變的趨勢。

en.title: Royal Schiphol Group Invests €801 Million in H1 2026 as Passenger Traffic Reaches 37.3 Million
en.summary: Royal Schiphol Group invested €801 million in airport quality during the first half of 2026 as part of a long-term €10 billion renewal plan by 2035. Across its three airports, passenger volume reached 37.3 million between January and June 2026, with Amsterdam Schiphol accounting for 32.7 million travelers. To support its capital investment program and ensure healthy cash flow, Schiphol issued €500 million in bonds. Additionally, airport noise incentives helped increase the proportion of the two quietest aircraft categories operating at Schiphol to 38% in the first half of 2026, compared with 29% during the same period in 2025.
body: Royal Schiphol Group has presented its financial and operational performance for the first six months of 2026. Across its network of Dutch airports—including Amsterdam Schiphol, Eindhoven Airport, and Rotterdam The Hague Airport—a total of 37.3 million passengers traveled between January and June 2026. This figure represents a 0.3% increase compared to the same period in the previous year. Main gateway Amsterdam Schiphol accounted for the largest share of passenger traffic, recording 32.7 million travelers.

The group dedicated a record €801 million to improving airport quality across its facilities during the first half of 2026. This capital expenditure is part of a broader long-term strategy to invest €10 billion in renewing Amsterdam Schiphol by 2035. Specific achievements in the first six months included completing the A Pier facility and adding specialized operational capacity to support progressive fleet electrification across the airport site.

As part of the broader Schiphol Centre Master Plan, the airport operator paid €317 million to relocate several KLM operational buildings. To deliver on its multi-year capital investment program and maintain operational quality enhancements while ensuring a healthy cash flow balance, Royal Schiphol Group successfully issued €500 million in bonds during the period.

Operational data also highlighted progress in noise reduction following modified airport charges introduced by Schiphol in 2025 to incentivize quieter operations. During the first half of 2026, aircraft classified under the two quietest operational categories accounted for 38% of total flight operations at Schiphol, demonstrating a notable increase from the 29% recorded during the corresponding period in 2025.
